2. By an order dated 12.12.70, the Sub-divisional Officer, Jamalpur, directed the Circle Officer (Revenue), Sherpur to take possession of a part of plot No. 14 Khatian No. 22 of Mouza Narayanpur, after evicting the unauthorised occupants, including the petitioner therefrom and to report compliance by 15.2.71. 

 4. A Division Bench of this court by a Judgment and order dated 6.12.76. made the said rule absolute and declared that the order dated 12.12.70, passed 13) the Sub-Divisional Officer, Jamalpur, in Case No. 56-EP/70-71, purporting to take possession of part of C.S. Plot No. 14, Khatian No. 22 of Mouza Narayanpur had been passed without any lawful authority and was of no legal effect. 

 5. It is the petitioner's case that he along with his mother, wife and children had been living on the said land, peacefully when Respondent Nos. 1 and 2 taking recourse to Martial Law Regulation started a case against the petitioner under M.L.R. 12 of 1975 through the Tahsildar, Sherpur Tahsil, being Sherpur P.S. Case No 14 dated 26.10.78. It is alleged that the case was started to harass the petitioner and some others, by floating the Judgment and order passed in Writ Petition No. 24 of 1971 and the case was on the allegation that the petitioner with his family members illegally grabbed Govt. acquired land at Mouza Narayanpur in Plot No. 14 Khatian No. 22.
